CustomField.description: When on, this client receives the automated 21-day "no order" WhatsApp follow-up (with the Re-order/Call Us button) on Wednesdays and Sundays. Turn off to stop those WhatsApp messages for clients who are not interested — internal team reminders are unaffected.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: On = send WhatsApp order follow-ups to this client. Off = never send them.
CustomField.label: Send WhatsApp Follow-Ups
